method: exact palette replacement only, followed by mature SVG/PDF rendering
scope: No geometry, label, engineering data or frozen source changed.
font_fallback: Noto Sans CJK SC installed; Windows font families are named only and not distributed.

figures.typography_basis: authored SVG font-size and physical/viewBox scale; editable text retained
figures.pdf_text_representation: vector outlines; no incorrect CFF ToUnicode retained
figures.visual_finding: Final PDF-derived PNG viewed at full returned resolution. Labels and connections preserved; no visible clipping or overlap. Source content/geometry invariant compared before rendering.
